datasets.name: Dataset with seasonal differences (summer to autumn and spring to winter)
datasets.verbatim: The dataset [56] has three bands with a spatial resolution of 0.3 m, which describes two different seasonal variations; the size of the images is 2700 × 4275 pixels.

datasets.name: SZTAKI Air Change Benchmark
datasets.verbatim: An image pair with a size of 952 × 640 is from SZTAKI Air Change Benchmark [57].

datasets.name: Earthquake-induced landslide detection dataset (Jiuzhaigou Valley)
datasets.verbatim: The preearthquake and postearthquake remote sensing images with a size of 4658 × 10 282 are selected from 1.5-m resolution satellite images (Google Earth, December 2016) and 1.5-m resolution UAV images (December 2017), respectively.

methods.name: UCDFormer
methods.summary: UCDFormer is an unsupervised change detection method that uses a transformer-driven image translation module to mitigate domain shift between bitemporal images. It then uses a reliable pixel extraction module, which fuses fuzzy c-means clustering and adaptive thresholding, to select changed/unchanged pixels for training a binary classifier (Random Forest) to produce the final change map.
methods.source: Qingsong Xu, Yilei Shi, Jianhua Guo, Chaojun Ouyang, and Xiao Xiang Zhu
methods.verbatim: Furthermore, we present a novel unsupervised CD method using a lightweight transformer, called UCDFormer... The code is available at https://github.com/zhu-xlab/UCDFormer.
